neighbours.label: '!' (or a run of plain dots like '..', '...', '....') that comes later in a passage which earlier used the one-character '…' ellipsis; strongest in longer passages with several earlier '…' and '!' marks. Quiet: the same '!' with no earlier '…' (plain commas or three ASCII dots instead), a '!' placed before the '…', and '?' or '.' in that final slot.
neighbours.notes: One-swap twins in probing: the same closing '!' reads ~0.01 without an earlier '…' and 0.05-0.16 with one; earlier ASCII '...' does not prime it; earlier '!' primes weakly (~0.05). Short single sentences rarely pass 0.20; the solver reached 0.37 by stacking several passages. Test sentences written blind by a label-only second author.
fire: Well… I waited all afternoon for the bus… and then it finally came!
She opened the box slowly… peeked inside… and screamed with joy!
Hmm… let me think… yes, I remember now!
The lights flickered… the door creaked… and then the cat jumped out!
I tried the recipe twice… it failed both times… but the third try worked!
So… you're telling me… we won the whole tournament!
The rain kept falling… and falling… and we just kept walking....
